[[File:JediTraineeCorranHorn.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Horn constructing his lightsaber]]
[[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] constructed his [[Color/Legends|silver]]-bladed '''[[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]''' on [[Courkrus]], using scrap parts from [[The Crash (cantina)|The Crash]]. Created using a [[Durindfire (crystal)|Durindfire]], along with an [[Emerald/Legends|emerald]] and [[Diamond/Legends|diamond]] (initially a [[Kubaz xirkonia]], which rapidly failed and was soon replaced) for the [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|focusing crystals]], from jeweled furniture in Corran's room, it was based on designs hidden in [[Rostek Horn]]'s columns for the [[Corellian Horticultural Digest]], using a method for emergencies that took an average of two days to finish.

It was a [[Dual-phase lightsaber/Legends|dual-phase lightsaber]], capable of increasing its length to three meters when twisted to bring its second set of crystals into alignment.
